name: 32425-attnlora-gptoss20b-1gpu
model: openai/gpt-oss-20b, served with the LoRA adapter VaarunC/gpt-oss-20b-lora (r=16, lora_alpha=32) attached to every request
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism, one vLLM engine. No router in front, no external cache tier, no KV connector.
architecture: Sparse MoE decoder, GptOssForCausalLM: 24 layers alternating sliding-window(128) and full attention, hidden 2880, 64 query heads / 8 KV heads, head_dim 64, 32 local experts with 4 active per token, expert intermediate 2880, mxfp4 expert weights, 4096 native context, ~13.8 GB of top-level safetensors for ~21B parameters and ~3.6B active per token.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=16, warmup the first 2%, no cooldown, bounded at 1000 requests with a 2700 s safety cap, static seed 32425. 16 streams against an engine admitting --max-num-seqs 16 loads it exactly to its admission limit, so nothing queues; the cap is a runaway guard and is deliberately loose.
workload: synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix_buckets, request_format plain: prompt EXACTLY 227 tokens and output EXACTLY 800 (min = max on both), greedy (temperature 0.0) with EOS ignored, prompts sharing no prefix and prefix caching off. Every request is routed through the adapter, so there is no un-adapted traffic in the mix. Prompts are tokenized with add_special_tokens=True, so the engine reports a few tokens more than 227 and reports its own count -- a known offset, not drift.
purpose: A specialized 20-billion-parameter writing assistant on one GPU, serving 16 concurrent users short prompts with long adapter-tuned replies.
launch:
# The engine's command line for this workload.
#
# `max-num-batched-tokens` is PINNED to what a real `vllm serve` resolves to on this card. Do not
# delete it as "the default": launched another way it can fall to 2048, which chunks a prompt that
# fits whole at 8192 -- a scheduling difference, not a cosmetic one.
# `model` is the mxfp4 repo openai/gpt-oss-20b, NOT the bf16 upcast under its `original/`: the two
# are served through different code paths and are different setups.
model: openai/gpt-oss-20b
tensor-parallel-size: 1
max-num-seqs: 16
enable-lora: true
max-loras: 1
max-lora-rank: 16
enable-prefix-caching: false
compilation-config: {"compile_sizes": [1, 2, 4, 8, 16]}
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
